originalFrontAuthority: Existing original remains canonical; the generated front is a consistency guide only.

findings: Two backs, two seats, two floral pillows and four feet agree across views.
Left/right profiles are mirrored, solid padded sides; rear is a continuous upholstered panel.
Depth is compact, roughly 60 percent of width.
Generated pixel scale/projection is approximate; preserve the original palette and fixed game camera when building.
Semi-transparent surrounding glow is excluded at native import alpha cutoff 224. Raw generation is preserved.
Profiles assigned to game yaw by observed backrest position; generated labels alone were reversed.

implementation.geometry: Shorter/deeper rounded back pads, lower rear shell, arms with independent XYZ corner radii and a padded upper lobe over a tapered lower frame, slimmer depth and outward floral pillows

projection.note: Couch side projection follows the flatter generated profiles. Front/rear retain the source camera; actors retain their shared camera with pelvis docking.

implementation.reviewScope: Firefox creator: four empty and occupied facings, each seat, both seats, standing, Oat/custom color; comparison at 90 degrees with collision/seat overlay; creator/comparison/field navigation after resize fix with zero console errors in a fresh Firefox session. Export art review includes front/rear three-quarter views. No authenticated seat-lease/construction transactions.
implementation.limitation: Generated views are illustrative and retain some projection/proportion differences; no exact all-angle reconstruction claim.
